thread:
carla: Quick post-deploy tally for v2.3.1 — canary + 20% rollout finished smoke set. Short summary: 3 failing synth probes (2 kv timeouts in eu-west, 1 tokenizer 503). Attaching quick outputs. @sven @priya please weigh in.

sven: Can you paste the p95 / error%? Is the rollout paused?

deploy-bot: rollout status: 20% (canary passed initial gate). Postdeploy smoke started at 1743219988. synth-run-id: synth-9321. Metrics snapshot: p95=120ms (target <150ms), 5xx rate=0.12% (baseline 0.03%), kv-timeouts=2 failures (both eu-west), tokenizer-503=1.

priya: Thanks — looks like a small kv warmup issue in eu-west. No OOMs reported in the infra logs. I recommend we HOLD further rollout until we re-run targeted synth for eu-west.

josh: quick log snippet from the failing probe:```
> GET /kv/prefill?key=probe-abc  HTTP/1.1
> Host: eu-west.api.internal
> 
HTTP/1.1 524 Gateway Timeout
[...stack truncated...]
trace: rpc=deadline exceeded after 2.0s
```

carla: My leaning is staggered pause (do not rollback). Pin routing in eu-west to v2.3.0 for new sessions while we validate warmup. Also update release notes to mention a transient kv probe spike in eu-west that we're monitoring.

sven: Agree with pause + pin. Priya — can you extend the change window +30m so SRE can run a warmup and rerun smoke?

priya: On it. Updated the release calendar (+30m) and alerted SRE rota. Queued a targeted re-run: synth-9322 (eu-west-only). Also enabling more frequent kv-prefill retries for the re-run.

deploy-bot: synth-9322 queued. Will post results when complete.

oncall-bot: pager suppression enabled for low-severity kv-timeouts on this rollout (suppress window: 30m).

josh: Decision rule: if synth-9322 drops 5xx to <=0.05% and p95 remains <150ms, we unpin and continue; if 5xx >0.2% or kv failures persist >3 in the next 10m, we rollback the tranche and open a hotfix ticket.

carla: :thumbsup: I'm adding the release-note snippet to the draft PR (#1124) now: "Note: transient kv probe spike observed in eu-west during rollout; behavior under investigation, no customer impact observed. Rollout paused in eu-west." Tagging docs.

deploy-bot: synth-9322 summary: PASS — tokenizer 503 gone, kv-timeouts reduced to 0 (retries succeeded), p95=118ms. Resuming rollout to 50% in 5m.

sven: Thanks everyone. I'll monitor dashboards during the resume and call for rollback if the error band reappears.

carla: Closing thread — followups in the release PR for postmortem if anything recurs.
